description: K1153 EU yfinance earnings 資料稀疏 (12/30 skip)，N=18 DAX-biased。改用 BaFin (DE)/AMF (FR)/FCA (UK) 本地 filing API 取完整 CAC+FTSE earnings，N=30 重測是否改變 θ_rel=0.137 cluster 歸屬。

description: K1153 推翻 quarterly-density hypothesis。新假說測試: 用 I/B/E/S analyst coverage count per stock × earnings-season media article volume 作為 cross-market predictor of θ_rel。若 correlation 顯著 → mechanism 確認。

description: K1164 panel coef 受 θ_rel = θ_EAV/σ² 機械 rank-inversion 污染。改 per-stock fit 取 θ_EAV_i (allow heterogeneity)，再用真正 cross-stock θ_EAV_i variation 跟 analyst/media correlate。

description: [K1166 within-market analyst CONFIRMED 後] retail-vs-institutional ownership 解 cross-market 4-market EU>JP rank inversion (EU LOW vs JP HIGH cluster). Proxy: US 13F, JP MOF, EU ECB SHS-S, TW FISC.

description: K1164 REJECTED 已被 K1166 翻轉為 within-market CONFIRMED + cross-market open。Paper 2 §5 必須改寫: K1164 從 main result 降為 'shared-pooled-coef σ² tautology demonstration', K1166 升為 main mechanism test。主線程改 paper/2/body.tex。

description: K1167 institutions_pct EU(0.416)≈JP(0.425) 但 θ_rel EU 0.14 << JP 0.39。新假說: 財報日 media coverage 集中度 (US Bloomberg/CNBC + JP 日經 single-source vs EU 多語言分散)。Proxy: GDELT or Bloomberg news count per earnings event per stock per market。

description: K1165 N=7 ρ=+0.750 p=0.052 緊貼門檻 (STRENGTHENED but not CONFIRMED)。+BR (Bovespa), CH (SSE), IN (Nifty) 至 N≥10 跨美洲+新興+亞洲, 預期 ρ p < 0.01 確定。

description: K1165 AU 0/10 stocks earnings via yfinance 不足。改 Alpha Vantage EARNINGS endpoint 或 ASX official disclosures 取得 ASX top-10 earnings dates, 加入 K1168 N≥10 panel。

description: K1168 BR/CH/IN θ_rel residuals 主因 yfinance institutional% 對新興市場不準: CH state-owned undercounted, IN promoter+FII inflated, BR control-shareholder ambiguous. 用 BCBS/CSRC/SEBI/CVM 官方數據 separate state-owned vs private institutions, 重做 N=10 cross-market regression。

description: K1174 only 1/96 slice coverage (1.04%) + 131/413 events. Need full-day (96 files) scan or GCP BigQuery (if user can provide auth) for N≥10 per market decisive PCR test. Current K1170 press concentration claim hangs on this.
